description: This file implements the WebAudioPlayerModuleService class, which manages Web Audio Player instances, handles client connections/disconnections, and provides RPC methods for controlling audio playback and querying buffer/device info within an IPC framework.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerModuleService
classes.description: Implements the IPC service for managing Web Audio Players, including creation, destruction, playback controls, buffer management, and device info queries.

methods.name: clientConnected
methods.description: Handles a new client connection, registers the client, and exports the service.

methods.name: clientDisconnected
methods.description: Handles client disconnection, cleans up associated handles, and destroys related Web Audio Players.

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Creates a new Web Audio Player instance with specified configuration and associates it with the client.

methods.name: destroyWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Destroys a specified Web Audio Player instance and updates client handle mappings.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts playback of the specified Web Audio Player.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses playback of the specified Web Audio Player.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Sets the end-of-stream flag for the specified Web Audio Player.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves the available buffer frames and shared memory info for the specified Web Audio Player.

methods.name: getBufferDelay
methods.description: Retrieves the current buffer delay in frames for the specified Web Audio Player.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes audio data to the Web Audio Player buffer.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device information such as preferred/max frames and support for deferred play.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume level for the Web Audio Player.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Retrieves the current volume level of the Web Audio Player.
